params.script_inline:
import sys, json

d = json.load(sys.stdin)["body"]
calls = [m for m in d.get("messages", []) if m.get("type") == "tool_call"]
if not calls:
    # Echo guard: error replies / non-tool input end here (terminal empty multi-send).
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps([]))
    sys.exit(0)

out = [{"header": {"route": "c_asst"}, "messages": calls}]
for i, c in enumerate(calls):
    wrapper = json.loads(c.get("text", "{}"))
    name = wrapper.get("name", "unknown")
    args = wrapper.get("arguments", "{}")
    if not isinstance(args, str):
        args = json.dumps(args)
    out.append({
        "header": {"tool_name": name},
        "messages": [{"origin": "assistant", "type": "tool_call", "id": c.get("id", "call-%d" % i), "text": args}]
    })
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(out))

description.purpose: M4 dispatcher, multi-send: unwraps ALL of the planner's OpenAI-form tool_calls ({name, arguments}) — one routed message per call (raw args, hop.tool_name) plus the assistant turn to the collector (c_asst lane) as the fan-in expectation set.
description.use_when: Between the loop llm and the tool cells; the run-4 'first tool_call wins' drop is gone (v2).
description.not_in_scope: No arg validation; unknown tool names route to the dead-letter drain edge.
description.emits_meaning: c_asst: the verbatim tool_call turns (thread row + expected-id set). Per call: one tool_call turn with raw args, hop.tool_name as routing discriminator. No tool_calls in input (e.g. substrate error reply echo) -> NOTHING (empty multi-send, terminal).
description.consumes_meaning: messages[]: the planner's assistant tool_call turns in OpenAI function-call form.
examples: 3 tool_calls -> 4 emissions: 1x c_asst (3 turns) + 3x {tool_name: web_search, args {query}}
